_comment: DO NOT GUESS. Childcare / friend coverage is set ONLY by the user, per study — never inferred by a model. An earlier version INVENTED per-city likelihoods (e.g. 'San Diego: likely', 'Phoenix: likely') and let them rank studies. That was wrong and is removed. The user gave a national friend list to justify listing studies EVERYWHERE (he'll travel), NOT to declare who can watch his daughter. Default every location to UNKNOWN; the user decides coverage study-by-study.
rule: Never assign childcare coverage from a model. Only the user sets it. Ranking MUST NOT depend on guessed childcare — rank on pay, nights, drive-vs-fly, payout timing, eligibility.
